title: SOVEREIGN ASCENSION — Unified Character Intelligence
features: Unified source-aware Sovereign Dashboard combines manual local characters, saved talent drafts and objectives with separately requested Blizzard public character/equipment data.
Talent Forge Ascension compares two existing locally stored builds by specialization identity and original node IDs/ranks; all previous saves remain unchanged.
Mission & Progression Operations creates five focused player pathways with direct studio links and JSON exports.
ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant 2.0 adds explicit evidence review explaining what is locally planned, officially reported, or unavailable.
Added read-only JSON snapshot preview/import, export, explicit public data lookup and cancellation, mobile-responsive UI and safe provenance labels.
Preserved v7.9.9 rollback branch, legacy music/Founder/Connected layout, Blizzard Worker, saved-data formats and prior studios.
Updated Gateway metadata, PC/mobile Player Handbook, Getting Started guide, Developer Test Requests, Device QA, changelog, regression tests and staged Release Center.
discord_message:
NEXUS | AZEROTH COMPANION v8.0.0 — SOVEREIGN ASCENSION

Major upgrade: one Sovereign Dashboard connecting manual character plans, saved Talent Forge builds, source-labeled public Blizzard equipment research and mission objectives.

NEW: Talent Forge Ascension saved-build comparison; integrated Mission & Progression Operations; ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant 2.0 evidence review; read-only snapshot import/export; premium PC/mobile workspace.

Existing player saves, Founder bubble, HYPER MUSIC, Connected account controls and prior tools are preserved.

Development preview pending real-player and device acceptance tests. The official release has NOT been announced.

https://zevromxr-hub.github.io/nexus-application-gateway/azeroth-companion/
Powered by ZevRo Development | NEXUS
acceptance_gates: Check physical desktop/iPhone layout and keyboard navigation
Verify live Blizzard public profile and equipped item data using a known character
Validate old v7.x Talent Forge and saved data retention across refresh, import and comparisons
Confirm secure Battle.net sign-in, verification and private account functionality unchanged
Verify mission and evidence assistant accuracy including unavailable/partial data
Check combined progression reports, Mythic+, raids, reputations, music and Founder controls
Confirm GitHub rollback branch and GitHub Actions validation tests are passing
Promote version metadata from staging to stable only after acceptance
publish_rule: Keep index.json on last official v7.9.3 until accepted. Never create releases/v8.0.0.json before tests pass; that exact path triggers guarded Discord announcement.
